# WO-616: Owner stage-2 test: attended search session on the owner's own PC, measure what really works
Status: queued (in-house; after WO-601 specs + WO-612)
Vendor: claude
Agent: qa-security (Marcus Webb)
Kind: tests
Tier: deep
Severity: HIGH
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes
Target release: 0.4
Source: owner direction 2026-11-11 ("find a way to fully automate"), after WO-601 showed every people-search page blocks a cloud fetch. PII-free by rule.
Boundary (all WOs 612-616): shared rule 5 stands. No CAPTCHA solving, no stealth plugins, no solver services, no UA or fingerprint spoofing, no proxies or IP rotation. "Fully automated" here means: the app does every step a machine may do, from the person's own computer, and asks the person only for the one click a site reserves for humans, batched so it happens rarely.

## Goal
Measure, from the owner's own home connection, how many sites the app can search with no human, how many need one click, and how many cannot be reached. This replaces the cloud-tool numbers in WO-601 with real ones.

## Tasks
- [ ] 1. Owner runs `freemyid scan --attended` on the test data folder (owner profile, consented 2026-11-11). Marcus watches outputs only.
- [ ] 2. Per broker: method used, outcome enum, clicks needed, parse ok, match level. Counts and broker names only; no personal values in any report.
- [ ] 3. Run again 24 h later to see how many sites need no click the second time (WO-612 item 5, WO-613).
- [ ] 4. One WO per failure class found.

## Allowed paths
- `~/.local/share/freemyid-owner-test-results/` (private, outside the repo)
- `docs/handoff/qa-security.md` (counts only)
